statements.impact_statement: Alpine v3.24 stable security data (https://secdb.alpinelinux.org/v3.24/main.json) and OSV (https://osv.dev/vulnerability/ALPINE-CVE-2026-107891) record the fix in 1.2.6-r3. Docker Scout incorrectly uses the edge r6 threshold (https://github.com/docker/scout-cli/issues/248). Applies only to this exact patched stable musl package in the DockerLocal socket proxy; other package versions and vulnerabilities are not exempted.
